sources.title: Artificial Intelligence-Driven Plant Disease Detection and Diagnosis: A ...
sources.snippet: Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly deep learning–based image analysis, offer scalable and automated solutions for plant disease recognition. This review critically examines forty-one peer-reviewed studies published between 2008 and 2025, selected following PRISMA guidelines from major scientific databases.
